## Documents

| [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) | AlgoDesk Next is a small core plus plugins. The core is organized in strict layers: `api` at the bottom; foundation packages (`fees`, `config`, `params`, `registry`, `journal`, `logs`, `data`, `screens`); trading execution layers (`oms`, `portfolio`, `risk`, `results`); `ops` and `devtools`; runtime `engine`; and `cli` on top. Plugins import only `algodesk.api`; the core never imports a plugin. Every adjustable number lives in the parameter registry, every event in a hash-chained journal, and every plugin load passes mode, capability and conformance gates. Orders follow a strict state machine with write-ahead journaling. Risk checks evaluate without short-circuiting, backed by an atomic persistent kill-switch. Import rules are enforced by tests. Market data, strategies, orders, notifiers, and brokers arrive as plugins. |
| [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) | Short decision records (context, decision, reason) in the order they were taken. They explain why the code looks the way it does. Each stays under 80 words; larger designs live in the PRD. Add a new record whenever a choice changes structure, tooling or a rule; never edit history, add a record that supersedes it. |
| [PLUGINS.md](PLUGINS.md) | A plugin is a folder `plugins/<kind>/<name>/` with a `plugin.toml` manifest, `plugin.py`, a README that starts with a Summary, and a `tests/` folder. It imports only `algodesk.api` (plus packages named in its manifest), declares every capability it supports, and fails loudly for anything else. `algodesk new plugin <kind> <name>` generates a valid skeleton; `algodesk plugins test <kind> <name>` runs its tests and base-contract checks and records a conformance pass tied to its code hash. Paper and live modes load only plugins with a current pass. |
| [PRD.md](PRD.md) | AlgoDesk Next is a small, pluggable trading workbench for Indian markets. A tiny core runs the workflow; everything that varies (brokers, data sources, execution venues, fees, indicators, screens, strategies, risk rules, notifiers, calendars, secrets, transports) is a separate plugin. One engine serves research, backtest, paper and live. Safety invariants live in code, strategies earn live status through promotion gates, every adjustable number sits in a central registry, and documents stay short and summary-first. This PRD is the requirements source for milestones M0 to M9; the Overview lists the decisions that shape everything, and later sections hold numbered requirements with acceptance tests. |
| [RUNBOOK.md](RUNBOOK.md) | Checklists for operating AlgoDesk Next from the terminal. Always start with `source scripts/env.sh` so Python, caches, and state stay inside the project folder. Before committing, run `bash scripts/check.sh` and expect `CHECK: PASS`. Run `algodesk doctor` for environment health (exit 0 OK, 1 warn, 2 critical). Change adjustable numbers only via `algodesk param set` with a reason. Never run backtest, replay, data, or kill-switch commands as an AI agent on the real repository; the owner runs them. |
| [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) | Milestones M0–M4 are complete. AlgoDesk Next provides a layered core and plugin workbench with TOML config, SQLite parameter registry, hash-chained journal, scrubbed logging, deterministic execution engine, historical data layer, indicators/screens, and reproducible backtester with reporting. Next: M5 design (risk and control). |
